message: Remember when we stayed up all night talking about nothing and everything? Best night ever.
You once made me laugh so hard I couldn't breathe. Never forgetting that.
Thank you for always picking up the phone, no matter the time.
That trip we took was chaotic, but I wouldn't trade it for anything.
You believed in me when I didn't believe in myself. That means everything.
Our inside jokes could fill an entire book at this point.
You have this way of making any bad day instantly better.
Here's to many more years of memories just like these.
